mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which can stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not exceed the baseline mean when FEDFUNDS is low, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests a weakening labor market, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive when UNRATE rises above 5%, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of slowing payroll employment growth and rising unemployment rate indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not show a negative correlation with the combined labor market indicators, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in industrial production may indicate supply chain strains, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive when INDPRO growth exceeds 5%, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not improve when retail sales are high, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising consumer prices (CPI) coupled with low unemployment may lead to monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises and UNRATE is low
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not show a negative correlation with the combined CPI and unemployment indicators, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not rise when housing starts increase, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth indicates a robust economy, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not exceed the baseline mean when GDP growth is strong, this hypothesis is falsified.
